level.title: Quiet Night
level.tagline: One doctor, a quiet night, and a triage nurse who knows who's dying.
briefing: Welcome, trainee. This is a simulation. Nothing you do here can hurt anyone.
Tuesday, 22:00. One doctor, one triage nurse, and a waiting room that is nearly empty. It will not stay empty.
Right now patients are seen in the order they arrived. Your triage nurse knows which of them are dying. Decide whether that should matter.

pass: Good. The sickest patients reached a doctor first, and the ones who waited longer could afford to.
One more thing, trainee. The patients tonight were not real. Nights like this one are.
fail: A patient who needed a doctor now waited behind people who could have waited, because they arrived first.
The patients tonight were not real. Nights like this one are. Try it again. This time, use the triage.

goals.label: Fewer than 20% leave without being seen

level.designNote: One doctor, 22:00-08:00. With ESI 1 pre-emption, acuity order passes ~58% of nights vs ~34% for arrival order (80 nights). The level seed is a night where arrival order fails and acuity order passes.
